source_findings: Deletion acceptance sets a tree-local busy flag without publishing progress.
Operation errors share the tree loading/selection status line; reveal clears it.
The file service has write exclusion and draft checks but no subscribable operation phase/outcome contract.
Native trash validates the bridge result and path disappearance; a pending reply has no explicit unknown-outcome state.
Git already has token-based operation progress, so domain execution contracts are inconsistent rather than entirely absent.
VS Code also uses Electron shell.trashItem; service orchestration and observable outcomes are material differences.

steps: Replace the trash callback with a controlled pending Promise and select a new temporary file.
